description: Report table + additional distinct dashboard cards: build the Report table with real table semantics (1126:19055, variants Course/Student/Exam/Lecture + Student Header) and the remaining distinct cards — CoursePerformance (1008:7826), RecentActivityCourse (1089:15840 states 1/2), Testimonials (711:9325), ExamCard (1166:23315), StudentOverview (1174:24931), StudentData (1173:24352). Build ONE component with variants where two Figma nodes are visually the same with different data. Depends on FEAT-001 and reuses patterns/components from FEAT-002/003 (Badge, icon chip, charts/ProgressRing). Run after FEAT-003.
steps: Read context.json and this file FIRST. get_design_context each node id (fileKey y0eOLyKLtTHnJYzOW046WR) before building; ADAPT to tokens, never paste raw Figma code.

Report — src/components/organisms/report.tsx (node 1126:19055). Use real table semantics: a Report wrapper rendering <table> with <thead>/<tbody>, plus a ReportRow component with a variant (course|student|exam|lecture) selecting which columns render. Observed columns: Course(course name,date,students count,amount,details,actions eye/trash); Student(student name,code,grade,date,actions); Exam(quiz name,exam number,mark,fail/pass badge,actions); Lecture(system/lecture name,attendance time+icons,actions). Header row driven by a columns config per variant with i18n fallback labels (organisms.dashboard.report.*). Reuse Badge for pass/fail (error/accent-light) and Button (icon) for actions. Prop-driven cells; logical alignment (text-start/text-end).

CoursePerformance — src/components/organisms/course-performance.tsx (node 1008:7826). Course KPI card (title + metric + a small chart or ProgressRing if the node shows one — reuse the FEAT-003 chart or the ProgressRing molecule, do not rebuild).
RecentActivityCourse — src/components/organisms/recent-activity-course.tsx (node 1089:15840). One component with a variant (1|2) for the two states.
Testimonials — src/components/organisms/testimonials.tsx (node 711:9325). Quote card: Avatar + name + role + body + star rating (RateIcon).
ExamCard — src/components/organisms/exam-card.tsx (node 1166:23315). Exam summary (title, date, duration, status Badge, CTA Button).
StudentOverview — src/components/organisms/student-overview.tsx (node 1174:24931). Student profile summary (Avatar, name, stats grid).
StudentData — src/components/organisms/student-data.tsx (node 1173:24352). Student data card (labelled field rows).
Barrel-export every new symbol (+ *Variants) from src/components/organisms/index.ts.

Add tests (NextIntlClientProvider + en.json) for the non-trivial ones at minimum: report.test.tsx (table role, per-variant column headers, a row's cells, action buttons), testimonials.test.tsx, exam-card.test.tsx, student-overview.test.tsx.
Any new i18n fallback strings go into organisms.dashboard in BOTH messages files, in sync.
acceptance_criteria: Report uses <table>/<thead>/<tbody> semantics (getByRole('table') works) with correct per-variant columns and header labels.
Each additional card is prop-driven, composed from existing atoms/molecules/icons (no duplicated styling), logical props, light+dark; visually-identical nodes are ONE component with variants.
All new organisms barrel-exported; non-trivial ones have passing unit tests; messages-parity green.
`npx vitest run src/components/organisms`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build` all succeed.
verification: npm run typegen; npm run typecheck
